hook: NoSQL chhoddo, [[JSON data]] ab SQL mein rakho

slides.title: SQL aur [[JSON]] ka mel
points: Modern databases **JSON** store kar sakte hain
slides.note: Bole toh: Ek hi column mein poora **profile object** rakh lena 📦

slides.title: JSON data [[store]] karo
Data nikalne ke [[operators]]
points: Nested keys ke liye `-> 'key'` use karo
slides.note: Double arrow `->>` sabse zyada use hota hai jab string chahiye 🎯

slides.title: Query mein [[access]]
slides.code:
SELECT 
  meta->>'city' AS city,
  meta->'skills'->0 AS first_skill
FROM users
WHERE meta->>'lang' = 'Hindi';
slides.note: PostgreSQL aur MySQL dono mein yeh syntax supported hai ⚡

slides.title: Query ka [[result]]
slides.note: Index `-> 0` se JSON array ka **pehla item** nikal gaya 📊

slides.title: Kahan use [[karein]]?
points: **User settings**: alag columns ka jhanjhat nahi
**API responses**: jaise ke taisi save karo

slides.wrong:
SELECT meta.city FROM users
-- dot operator se access
slides.right:
SELECT meta->>'city' FROM users
-- JSON arrow operators use karo
slides.why: SQL column dot notation JSON ke andar nahi ja sakta, arrow operators zaroori hain ⚠️

points: `->` object deta hai, `->>` text deta hai
NoSQL ki flexibility, SQL ki safety

caption:
NoSQL ki zaroorat nahi, JSON ab seedha SQL mein rakho 📦

Is post mein:
✅ SQL mein JSON table banana
